thread:
Tara M.: Quick ask — we need a pack of short rebut scripts (8x) for field ops vs cloud LLM endpoints and generic managed LLM APIs. Keep each to a 1-line opener + 1 supporting fact. Deadline: EOD tomorrow so SDRs have them for Wed webinar prep.

Kevin L.: Got it. I'll sketch 4 now and finish the rest tonight.

Maria S.: Can we make sure at least 3 of them call out latency/cost differences (real numbers) not just generic claims? SDRs want hard bullets.

Alex P.: I can pull the 99p latency p95 vs most cloud endpoints from the latest perf run. Link: https://redwood.internal/bench/2026-03-llm-endpoint-run — will paste numbers in a sec.

Kevin L.: Drafting — dropping first two here, feedback welcome:
```
1) "We scale inference cost-effectively — our batching + KV cache reduces per-token cost vs single-tenant endpoints."
   - Measured: ~2.3x token-cost savings on chat workloads vs default managed endpoint (2026-03 bench).
2) "Consistent 95th percentile latency even under burst — less tail jitter for interactive apps."
   - P95: 180ms vs 430ms on a comparable multi-tenant endpoint (same model/seq).
```

Priya R.: Nice. Can we shorten phrasing for SDR copy? Something like:
- "Lower per-token cost (2.3x)"
- "Lower tail latency (P95 180ms)"
Those are quick soundbites.

Kevin L.: Yup — will convert to short hooks.

Maria S.: Also add one that addresses "model drift/regression" — call out our rollout + evals pipeline. Ops teams ask that a lot.

Alex P.: Adding snippet from runtime team: "Canary rollouts, automatic fallback to quantized variants, continuous evals on prompt sets — reduces regressions in production."

ops-bot: Reminder — product collateral review due in 24h for external-facing claims.

Priya R.: We should include an objection handler for "we already use cloud managed endpoints" — quick reply: "If cost/latency/regressions matter, teams switch — we help migrate with minimal code changes + identical API surface."

Kevin L.: Adding migration hook. Also preparing a tiny one-pager for SDRs with 6 rebut lines + 2 FAQ bullets. Draft link: https://docs.google.com/field-rebuts/RED-123 (will update).

Maria S.: For accuracy, Alex can you paste the two cost/latency numbers into the doc? Don't want SDRs quoting wrong figures.

Alex P.: Pasted. Also added model/quantization footnote: "2.3x cost is sample median across chat evals when KV caching + batching enabled; individual results vary by seq distribution."

Tara M.: Great progress. Final asks: (1) convert to 1-line soundbites + 1 supporting bullet each, (2) add one-liner competitor-specific rebut for largest cloud provider we see in deals, (3) attach bench link and a short how-to for SDRs to share a link to the benchmark during calls.

Kevin L.: Will ship final pack by 6pm PT.

Priya R.: I'll prepare the SDR handoff snippet + suggested email templates after you post.

Tara M.: Thanks team :raised_hands: — please ping when done and I'll schedule a 15-min sync tomorrow morning if anything needs sign-off.

Kevin L.: Posted final pack in the doc and flagged for review. ping @Maria S. @Priya R.

Maria S.: Reviewed and tiny edit. Approved. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Document review completed (2 approvers).

Tara M.: Approved. Closing thread — follow-up in the webinar prep channel if we need live roleplay.
